source.title: Shimmering Dust — firsthand Wowhead comments describing catch-up drops

quote: you HAVE TO do the weeklies first
notes: Multiple commenters describe a weekly profession-knowledge prerequisite for Shimmering Dust catch-up drops. This is a reported gating condition, not a confirmed deterministic skill gate; do not classify it as baseline material from ordinary rare-gear DE. Exact preconditions vary by character/week; see Sarthorius and CodisJ1286 comments.
requires: Reported after obtaining other weekly Enchanting knowledge sources and qualifying for catch-up profession knowledge; source reports weekly gating, needs in-game confirmation.

quote: I've blown up about 400 crap blues I make on my tailor.
notes: Independent first-person report from February 2025 of approximately 400 crafted blues and reported catch-up Shimmering Dust 'around 52-55%' drop rate (approximate range; not one exact percent), with about 200 knowledge drops. Neither 400 nor 200 is exact, so numeric casts, totalQuantity, P(hit), zero results and histogram all stay null. Weekly catch-up gating means this must NOT contribute to ordinary DE baseline, and gear item IDs/skill are unstated. Distinct from the Looter item-223548 cohort.
